# Fotor

> Fotor is a comprehensive online photo editing and design platform featuring AI-powered tools for image enhancement, collage creation, and content generation.

Fotor offers both a free web-based editor and premium subscription plans with advanced AI capabilities. The platform serves both individual creators and developers through its API portal, providing tools for photo editing, video enhancement, image generation, and batch processing.

## Key Topics

- AI Photo Editor
- Background Remover
- Image Upscaler
- Collage Maker
- Photo Effects
- AI Image Enhancement
- AI Video Editor
- Free Online Editor
- Batch Processing
- Photo Retouching
- Text-to-Image
- Image Manipulation
- AI Filters
- Video Enhancement
- API Integration

## Core Photo Editing Tools

- [Photo Editor: Free Online Photo Editing & Image Editor | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com): Fotor's main homepage featuring free online photo editing with AI-powered tools.
- [AI Photo Editor - Free Online Automatic AI Photo Editing | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/ai-photo-editor): Fotor's AI photo editor with automatic enhancement and text-prompt editing.
- [Photo Retouching | Retouch Photos Online for Free | Fotor Photo Editor](https://www.fotor.com/features/photo-retouching): AI-powered photo retouching with beauty tools like blemish remover and airbrush.
- [Add Photo Effects Online: Apply Artistic & Cinematic Filters | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/photo-effects): Apply artistic and cinematic photo effects with Fotor's free online editor.
- [Add Text to Photo Online: Free Text Adder | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/text.html): Free text editor for adding customizable text to images across platforms.

## Image Manipulation & Transformation

- [Image Resizer: Simply Resize Images Online for Free | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/resize.html): Free online image resizer tool for optimizing visuals without quality loss.
- [Free Image Cropper：Crop Image Online with Custom & Preset Ratios | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/crop): Free image cropping tool with custom and preset ratios for social media.
- [Photo Frame Editor: Add Borders to Photo Online for Free | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/frames): Free photo frame editor for adding customizable borders and frames.

## Design & Content Creation

- [Collage Maker: Create Collages Online for Free | Fotor](https://www.fotor.com/features/collage): Fotor's free collage maker with 1000+ templates and AI-powered features.

## Developer & API Resources

- [Advanced AI APIs to Empower Content-Centric Businesses | Fotor](https://developers.fotor.com): Developer portal for Fotor's AI APIs including image generation and background removal.
